collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: It is far too hot for anyone to do anything: go swimming at midday, or lie very still in the shade.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It is so hot today that nobody can do anything. The air is thick and still. The birds have stopped singing. Even the dogs are lying flat in the shade, panting. (subject) is sitting in the doorway with a wet cloth on (subject.his/her) head, and (friend) has just staggered up to suggest something.

choices.label: Lie Very Still in the Shade

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "The sea," says (friend). They go. Half the village is already there, sitting in the shallows with only their heads out of the water, like a row of coconuts. (subject) and (friend) join them. Nobody talks. Nobody moves. It is the most pleasant thing in the world.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) suggests lying in the shade and not moving at all. They lie side by side under a big tree. They don't speak. Occasionally one of them sighs. In the late afternoon a breeze finally comes in off the sea, and they both make a noise of such pure relief that a nearby dog lifts its head.
